sloka: इमौ तु जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातकौ ।सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षौ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ।। ७.९६.१८ ॥
transliteration: imau tu jānakīputrāvubhau ca yamajātakau ।sutau tavaiva durdharṣau satyametadbravīmi te ।। 7.96.18 ॥

translations.english: These two formidable sons, born as twins to Janaki, are indeed your own sons, and I speak this truth to you.
